title: [3.0-rc3] Prime/fill on disconnected pump creates bolus entry
body:
Hi, I did following:

1) Pump was disconnected.
2) Prime/fill button used twice to send 0.25 and 0.25 units.
3) Pump was auto-reconnected after 60 mins.

- What I have got are two entries of 0.25 units. First one is prime/fill (expected) but second one is normal bolus entry counted in IOB (unexpected). Here with Dana-RS pump. Here are logs [AndroidAPS.zip](https://github.com/nightscout/AndroidAPS/files/7921196/AndroidAPS.zip)

- In my second setup with dana-r pump I did this case again but it worked without problems.

- I also noticed that if the pump auto-reconnects there is no entry about it in treatments.
